items.title: Perplexity AI startup program

items.summary: Grok for Startups from SpaceXSI (formerly xAI) gives venture-backed startups one credit balance across Grok, Grok Build, Grok Bot and the Grok API. Credits are sized by funding, revenue and current AI spend, aiming for about six months of real usage.

items.title: Amplitude startup program

items.title: Clerk startup program

items.title: Cloudflare startup program

items.title: Customer.io startup program

items.title: Datadog startup program

items.title: Deel startup program

items.title: Figma startup program

items.title: HubSpot startup program

items.title: Linear startup program

items.title: Loom startup program
